The '''Guudria system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Guudrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DarkStryder" /><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Guudrian]]|system=Guudria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Guudria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square R-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
